Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

customer — a person who buys something. Example: The customer pays at the till.
cashier — a person who takes payment. Example: The cashier says the total.
bag — a container you carry things in. Example: Could I have a bag, please?
total — the full amount to pay. Example: The total is twelve euros.
receipt — the paper proving you paid. Example: Here is your receipt.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Is that everything?
• The total is ...
• Could I have a bag, please?
• Can I pay by card?
• Thank you, goodbye.
